links.outcome: Error types and counts in LLM-generated ED records, and correlation with clinical scores
links.effect: Invalid generation errors most common (35.38% of errors); structural malformation had largest negative impact on clinical score (r=-0.654); error count correlated with lower scores (r=-0.633).
links.quote: Quantitative analysis revealed that invalid generation errors were the most common, constituting 35.38% of total errors, while structural malformation errors had the most significant negative impact on the clinical evaluation score (Pearson r=-0.654; P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Clinician Likert-scale plus error-categorization framework for evaluating LLM-generated ED records, with interrater and test-retest reliability

screen.reason: Empirical usability and evaluation study assessing an evaluation framework and error taxonomy for LLM-generated emergency department medical records produced during a prompt-a-thon, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail or practice comparatively.
